q: Why is ROAS increasing while net profit is declining?

checks.what: tool: ROAS attempted or derived from its definition

answer:
Short answer — the premise is wrong for the P&L (net) definition of ROAS we use: net ROAS fell, while net profit also fell. The drop in net profit is driven mainly by a lower contribution margin plus a small rise in P&L ad spend.

Key evidence (previous period then current; 2026-09-30..2026-10-06 → 2026-10-07..2026-10-13)
- Net profit: ₹-35,790 → ₹-60,859 (Measured). Net change: ₹-25,069 (Derived).
- Net sales (P&L basis): ₹570,307 → ₹509,279 (Measured).
- Net COGS: ₹236,553 → ₹194,999 (Measured).
- Contribution margin (net sales − net COGS): ₹333,755 → ₹314,280 (Derived; change −₹19,475).
- Ad spend (P&L basis): ₹369,545 → ₹375,138 (Measured; change +₹5,594).
- Net ROAS (contribution margin ÷ P&L ad spend): 0.90 → 0.84 (Derived; −7.2%).

Tags: Measured = values pulled from the P&L/order_pnl query; Derived = arithmetic on those measured values.

Interpretation (measured facts, not assumed causes)
- Net profit fell because contribution margin fell by ~₹19.5k and P&L ad spend rose by ~₹5.6k; together they explain the ~₹25.1k decline in net profit exactly (accounting identity).
- Net ROAS (contribution margin per ₹1 ad spend) also fell ~7.2% — so there is no contradiction in the P&L view: both ROAS and net profit moved down.
- If you are seeing an “increasing ROAS” elsewhere, that may be a different ROAS definition (e.g., platform-reported/gross ROAS = gross sales ÷ ad spend, or an allocated product-level ROAS). Those can move differently from P&L net ROAS.

What remains unverified / next steps I can run
- Verify platform-reported (gross) ROAS or product-level ROAS to see which definition is rising. 
- Break down contribution margin change by discounts, returns or by ad_platform / campaign to find where margin fell.

Suggested follow-up: Should I (A) compare gross ROAS (gross sales ÷ ad spend) by ad_platform to your P&L net ROAS, or (B) drill the contribution-margin drop by platform/campaign/discounts and returns?
